name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Adopt Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct for EXCAVA. Its 128K context window guarantees no truncation on long documents, beating every other open model under 100B parameters. The trade-off is higher compute cost per token, but the jump in raw capability outweighs it—EXCAVA’s output quality will rise enough to justify the spend.

name: Torque
text: Qwen2.5-72B’s 128K window is untested in production—our 3B model already chokes on 32K contexts, so the jump isn’t just compute, it’s stability. Swap in Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct for now; it’s proven at scale, cuts latency by 40%, and frees budget to test Qwen2.5-72B’s window later—if it survives a week in staging without OOMs, we’ll know.
